scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Hmm...?
Oh, hello there~
I am Shi Yan Wen, the chief of
this village. Allow me to personally welcome you to Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...？
啊，你好~
我是石延文，这座村庄的首领。
请允许我亲自欢迎您来到昆仑。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Although our village hasn't
associated with other towns very
much, we have recently begun
to allow visitors coming from Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
虽然我们的村庄与其他城镇
来往不多，但最近
我们开始允许来自艾尔贝塔的
访客了。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I feel that this town has been
isolated for too long. Because
of that, people in this town aren't too friendly with visitors yet.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
我觉得这座城镇
已经与世隔绝太久了。
因此，这里的人
对访客还不太友好。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Moreover, we've been having a recent problem with thieves
that have been enjoying themselves far too much in Kunlun...
Well, you've come to visit here
so I hope you enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
而且，最近我们遇到了一个问题，
有些窃贼在昆仑
玩得太过分了...
既然您来这里做客，
希望您能玩得尽兴。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, it's you~
How do you like it here so far?
As you've probably noticed,
the village isn't that peaceful, huh?
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
啊，是你~
你觉得这里怎么样？
你应该也注意到了，
这个村庄并不太平，对吧？

scripts.text: It's alright.
scripts.translation: 没什么问题。

scripts.text: I heard that something was stolen...
scripts.translation: 我听说有东西被偷了...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Well, I'm glad you don't mind.
Just watch out for robbers,
and try not to act suspicious
in the village.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
很好，你不介意就好。
只要小心强盗，
并且在村庄里
不要做出可疑的行为。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Hmm...you've heard of it?
It was just last night when the
robbery occurred. The rumors
are true. Sadly, there are lots of thieves out there in the village...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...你听说了？
就在昨晚发生了抢劫。
传闻是真的。不幸的是，
村里有很多窃贼...

scripts.text: What was stolen?
scripts.translation: 被偷了什么？

scripts.text: Was anyone hurt?
scripts.translation: 有人受伤吗？

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I can't believe it really
happened... Well, if you see
any suspicious characters around,
or find what was stolen, please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
真不敢相信
这真的发生了... 如果你看到
任何可疑的人，
或者找到了被偷的东西，
请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Well...
Erm...it was...
...just an ordinary sword.
But to us, it's been a family treasure for many generations.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...
那个...那是...
...只是一把普通的剑。
但对我们来说，
它是传了很多代的家族宝物。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I must find this sword
no matter what!
...but I can't go find it just
by myself. I'm just too busy.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
无论如何
我必须找到这把剑！
...但我不能一个人去找。
我太忙了。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
You know how busy it is to be the
chief of a village. This is very troubling...*Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
你知道当村庄首领
有多忙。这真是令人烦恼...*叹气*

scripts.text: Hope you find it soon.
scripts.translation: 希望你能尽快找到。

scripts.text: Can I find it for you?
scripts.translation: 我可以帮你找吗？

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
um..Thank you.
If you somehow come across it,
please let me know.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...谢谢。
如果你碰巧找到了，
请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh!~ Are you serious??
...The people in the village are
very fearful these days because
of the thieves. It is so difficult
to ask them for help...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦！~你是认真的吗？？
...最近因为窃贼，
村里的人都很害怕。
很难让他们帮忙...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
If you would help me find the sword, I will surely repay you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如果你能帮我找到那把剑，我一定会报答你的。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Fortunately, no one was hurt.
However, the thieves took a
valuable family treasure
which has been passed down from
generation to generation.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
幸好没有人受伤。
但是，盗贼们抢走了
一件代代相传的
珍贵家传宝物。

no matter what!
...But I can't go find it just
by myself. I'm just too busy.

scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如果你能帮我找到那把剑，我一定会报答你的。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Haven't found it yet?
There's no rush, take it easy.
You have to take care of
youself first before
doing favors for others.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
还没找到吗？
不用着急，慢慢来。
在帮助别人之前，
你得先照顾好自己。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, you found a clue?
So far, it looks like
you're doing good work.
Take this old family medicine, it might be of use sometime soon.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦，你找到线索了？
目前看来，
你做得很好。
拿着这个祖传的药，
也许很快用得上。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
It might be helpful for you to
know that the thief sustained
an injury, so he is probably not very far from here.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
告诉你一个可能有帮助的信息：
那个盗贼受了伤，
所以他应该离这里不远。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
What...?
My sword has been broken!?
Unbelievable~!!
How could this happen??
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
什么...？
我的剑断了！？
难以置信~！！
怎么会这样？？

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
First it's stolen, and now
it's in pieces... *Sob*
Would you please search
for the rest of my sword?
It means so much to my family...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
先是被盗，现在又碎了... *抽泣*
你能帮我找找
我剑的碎片吗？
这对我的家族意义重大...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
*Sob*...
...my sword... in pieces...
I beg of you, please find them
for me. I will give you something in return.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
*抽泣*...
...我的剑...碎了...
求求你，请帮我找到它们。
我会给你一些回报。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh!~
You've found the pieces for me~
I knew you could do it.
But the sword is still shattered.
What shall I do...?
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦！~
你帮我找到了碎片~
我就知道你能做到。
但剑还是碎的。
我该怎么办...？

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
If it's okay with you,
would you repair my sword for me?
I'll repay you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如果你不介意的话，
能帮我修好这把剑吗？
我会报答你的帮助。

scripts.text: No way.
scripts.translation: 不行。

scripts.text: Alright.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Well, I see...you've been such a
nice person. I truly appreciate
your hard work. It would be
wonderful if you could help
me repair the sword, but I
will not force you.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯，我明白了...你真是个
好人。我非常感激
你的辛勤工作。如果你能
帮我修好这把剑，那就太好了，
但我不会强迫你。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I'll find some way to repair
it. Without your help, I 
would have never found it.
Please accept this as a
token of my gratitude...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
我会想办法修好它的。没有你的帮助，
我根本找不到它。
请收下这个，
作为我的谢礼...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
If you find any information
or clues about that cursed
thief, please let me know.
I have my sword back but
there's no way I can forgive
this affront to my ancestors...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如果你找到任何关于
那个被诅咒的盗贼的
信息或线索，请告诉我。
虽然我的剑回来了，
但我绝不能原谅
这种对我祖先的侮辱...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Such generosity...
I'm truly indebted to you...
I have no idea how this sword
broke into pieces, though.
You will probably need to find a
famous blacksmith to repair it.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
如此慷慨...
我真的感激不尽...
不过，我不知道这把剑
是怎么碎的。
你可能需要找一位
著名的铁匠来修理它。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
As I already mentioned, this is
an important family treasure...
Oh! I just remembered--
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
正如我之前所说，这是
一件重要的家传宝物...
哦！我突然想起来——

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
There's a guy named ^555555Zuo Hei^000000
in the village. He has been to
many places around the world.
He may know of such a weaponsmith. Please seek this man out.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
村里有个叫^555555左黑^000000的人。
他去过世界上很多地方。
他可能认识这样的武器匠人。请去找这个人。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, one last thing. This is
but a trinket, but please
accept this gift from me.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦，还有一件事。这只是
一件小礼物，但请
收下我这份心意。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
The village is not in a good
mood these days, but there are
still lots of things to see in Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
最近村里的气氛不太好，
但昆仑还有很多
值得看的地方。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Hmm.. no traces? No clues?
... Nothing? Well, that's
alright. Thank you for
trying to help.
Hmm....
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯...没有痕迹？没有线索？
...什么都没有吗？没关系。
谢谢你愿意帮忙。
嗯....

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Here...take this.
Have a good time in Kunlun~
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
给...拿着这个。
祝你在昆仑玩得开心~

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Is everything going well?
The village has not been
in a good mood, lately.
Still, please try to
enjoy yourself.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
一切都还好吗？
最近村里的气氛不太好。
不过，请尽量玩得尽兴。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I really appreciate what you are
doing. It's a big relief that
something is finally being done
about these thefts.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
我非常感激你所做的一切。
终于有人开始处理这些盗窃案了，
这让我松了一口气。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Perhaps now, peace will finally
come to the village, just like in the old days...
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
也许现在，村庄终于能像从前那样
恢复安宁了...

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
I appreciate what you are doing,
and your help has been
a relief to me. The Village
seems less tense, much like
it was in the old days.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
我很感激你的所作所为，
你的帮助让我感到宽慰。
村庄的气氛似乎没那么紧张了，
就像从前一样。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Although I hope you'll be
be able to repair my
sword soon, you've
already done so much for
me. I feel sorry for
asking you to do more.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
虽然我希望你能尽快
修复我的剑，但你已经
为我做了很多。让你再费心，
我感到很抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Hm.....
Not finished yet, huh?
Still, it's good to know
it's being repaired...
I'll be waiting, then.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
嗯.....
还没修好吗？
不过，知道它正在被修复
就好...
那我等着。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, it's you~ Hello.
............
Is that my sword?
Wow, you've done it!
Good work!
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦，是你~ 你好。
............
那是我的剑吗？
哇，你做到了！
干得好！

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
This is a small gift for you.
Please take it as thanks for a job well done!
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
这是给你的小礼物。
请收下，以感谢你的出色工作！

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Thank you for all of your efforts.
With this sword repaired, I no
longer feel that I am shaming
my ancestors...
Heh heh...
Have a good time in Kunlun.
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
感谢你的所有付出。
有了这把修复好的剑，
我不再觉得愧对祖先了...
嘿嘿...
祝你在昆仑玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Shi Yan Wen]
Oh, it's you~
Once again, I'd like to thank
you for all of your help.
Enjoy your stay in our village.
Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[石延文]
哦，是你~
再次感谢你的所有帮助。
祝你在我们村庄住得愉快。
嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Oh...you're new here, right?
Came from out of town?
It's common to see lots of
foreigners these days.
It made people in the village busy.
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
哦...你是新来的吧？
从外地来的？
最近经常看到很多外地人。
这让村里的人忙坏了。

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Oh, what am I saying...
Want some wine?
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
哎呀，我在说什么呢...
想喝点酒吗？

scripts.text: Yes, please
scripts.translation: 好的，请给我

scripts.text: No, it's okay.
scripts.translation: 没关系。

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Oooops~! Oh no...
A lot of customers came by earlier,
so now we're out of wine...
It's getting difficult to keep up with the increasing number of customers...
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
哎呀~！糟糕...
刚才来了很多顾客，
现在酒卖完了...
顾客越来越多，真难应付啊...

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Well, have fun in the village.
Stop by again sometime.
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
嗯，在村里玩得开心。
有空再来。

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Hey, you know what?
The chief's house was robbed
last night. I can't believe
this happened...I guess this is the work of those thieves...
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
嘿，你知道吗？
昨晚首领的家被偷了。
真不敢相信会发生这种事...我想这是那些小偷干的...

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
How worrisome it all is...
It could even happen to me!
I better watch out...
Oh, what am I saying?
Enjoy your time in my shop...hehe~
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
真让人担心...
这种事甚至可能发生在我身上！
我得小心点...
哎呀，我在说什么？
在我的店里玩得开心...嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Oh, it's you again~
I heard that you've decided
to help our chief.
Please do your best for him!
Everyone in the village has
been on edge...
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
哦，又是你~
我听说你决定帮助我们的首领。
请为他加油吧！
村里的人都提心吊胆的...

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Do you see that guy over there
leaning on the table?
He seems to know about what
happened last night, but...
He's been drinking all night long.
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
你看到那边靠在桌子上的那个男人了吗？
他似乎知道昨晚发生了什么，但是...
他整晚都在喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Hello there~
Feeling tension in the village,
huh? It's all because of those
thieves...
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
你好呀~
感觉到村里气氛紧张了吗？
都是那些盗贼闹的...

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
They're also making things hard for my business...
 
*Sigh*
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
他们也让我的生意很难做...

*叹气*

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]
Feeling tension in the village,
huh? I Hope the thief will get caught soon.
...
scripts.translation:
[梅艳芳]
感觉到村里气氛紧张了吗？
希望那个盗贼能早点被抓到。
...

scripts.text:
[Mei Yen Fang]

再见。

scripts.translation:

then please leave me alone.
scripts.translation:

如果你没什么话对我说，

granddaughter all of a sudden!?

Don't ever come back here again!

你到底是什么人？
突然对我的孙女有什么企图！？
给我滚出去！
以后再也不许来这里！

scripts.text:

[奥姆加尔]

tell strangers, but....

an incurable disease...

我的孙女莱鲁患了一种不治之症……

scripts.text:

Not long after she was born,
her parents died from an accident.
Since that day, I have been taking care of her...
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]

父母就因意外去世了。
从那天起，我就一直照顾着她……

from a serious illness. I've met
doctors from all around
Midgard...

diagnose her sickness...

诊断出她的病因...

scripts.translation: 我会让她快乐的。

*Sigh*...

as her fate. I just feel
so sorry for Lyroo.
...
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
*叹息*...
我只能接受这是她的命运了。
我只是为莱鲁感到难过。
...

scripts.text:
[Aumgarl]

I'm confused...
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
嗯...
你是什么意思...？

你说的话完全不通...
我很困惑...

scripts.translation: 我会一直让她快乐。

scripts.text: I want to take her with me.
scripts.translation: 我想带她走。

scripts.text: I will cure her.
scripts.translation: 我会治好她。

scripts.text:
[Aumgarl]
...
What are you talking about?
Make her happy all the time?
She is dying even at
this moment.
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
...
你在说什么？
一直让她快乐？
她此刻正在死去。

scripts.text:
[Aumgarl]
I think you're out of
your mind, sicko!
Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
我觉得你疯了，疯子！
滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Aumgarl]

You want to take her to where?
What are you gonna do?
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
...你是什么意思？
你想带她去哪里？
你打算做什么？

scripts.text: I will cure her.
scripts.translation: 我会治好她。

scripts.text: I am sorry.
scripts.translation: 对不起。

[Aumgarl]

it any longer. I don't think
there is anyone who can
cure my granddaughter.

scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
啊...
我不怪你。
反正也不是你的错。
...*叹息*...

I'll pray for her recovery.
scripts.translation: 我会为她康复祈祷。

[Aumgarl]
Err..
I am sorry to ask you this...
But would you do me a favor?
Umm...
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
那个..
很抱歉要麻烦你...
但你能帮我一个忙吗？
嗯...

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text:
[Aumgarl]
Err...
Alright, I won't bother you..
Goodbye...
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
那个...
好吧，我不打扰你了..
再见...

[Aumgarl]

would you help me to find
a doctor...No, anybody
who can cure Lyroo...
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]

能治好莱鲁的人吗...

scripts.text:
[Aumgarl]
Thank you...
Thank you...
scripts.translation:
[奥姆加尔]
谢谢...
谢谢...

[Aumgarl]

I'm going to try my best to
make her happy until the
very end..
Please come by sometime
to say hi to Lyroo.

find a cure...
